breakeven_capture_note: null when the gross edge is not positive: there is no fraction of a move to capture

cost_model.notes: Binance USDT-M taker at VIP0, no fee discount assumed. One leg per symbol position; a rebalance holds 30 positions and each pays its own round trip.

notes: Historical replication on archived data this family has already examined. Promotion requires a forward window on the live REST feed.
return_note: bps summed over trades at one unit of notional each, no compounding and no netting of overlapping positions
t_stat_net_artefact_note: diagnostic only — a t on a net series with constant cost measures the cost, not the signal
